basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old software engineer from Ann Arbor, Michigan, who loves fishing and enjoys playing video games in my downtime. I work remotely, which allows me the flexibility to explore various hobbies. I'm an avid fan of anime, particularly Little Witch Academia, and I frequently experiment with computer vision projects using OpenCV. I'm single, enjoy the occasional weekend fishing trip, and my online hours are mostly in the evenings. I like exploring new mods in games, but I dislike repetitive gameplay and unnecessary daily log-in rewards.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working in the software industry for over 10 years. My expertise lies in computer vision and machine learning, largely self-taught through online courses and personal projects. I also have an interest in game modding and software development.
